coverageSchema.wireFormat: [tag,unsignedRawValue] or [tag,childWireArray]; wire0/2 implied by schema; uint64 values are decimal strings; sint32 is preserved as raw ZigZag and decoded as -(raw&1) XOR (raw>>1)

uncertainty.lte: Native byte12 multiplied by1000 metres; not a surveyed-site guarantee
uncertainty.nr: Native ALSLocation reported horizontal accuracy in metres; confidence level/calibration unknown
uncertainty.coverage: Grid cell bounds only; no site uncertainty circle
uncertainty.flyover: Virtual camera and catalog anchors; no site/location uncertainty inferred
uncertainty.wifi: Native ALSLocation reported horizontal accuracy in metres; confidence level/calibration unknown; not locally observed AP/site verification

interpretation.catalog: All 102,274 mapped-source rows from the sealed Atlas, not towers, devices or visits. Original private evidence remains unchanged. Coverage and tour details load only when requested.
interpretation.privacy: Real nonpersonal technical values retained. Wi-Fi MAC and encoded MAC payloads, private plan/session/path metadata and private tour response paths removed. No personal history, local user/account identifiers or credentials included.
interpretation.siteLinks: Zero independently verified full-identity-to-physical-site links in the reviewed evidence set. Coverage PCI context is not an identity assignment.
interpretation.times: Provider history, permit dates, acquisition dates and unknown observation times are distinct. No device movement timeline is established.
interpretation.sourceUse: Research preview. OpenCellID-derived measurements are CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution; Apple-feed and other source-specific reuse questions remain unresolved. No independently verified vendor license grant or endorsement is asserted. No blanket license is applied to this mixed-source collection.
